categories.evidence: Labeled Tests and modifies test files (src/test/script_*.cpp, src/test/sigopcount_tests.cpp), but touches script-specific unit tests rather than test infrastructure or framework machinery.
categories.rationale: This PR does not belong to test infrastructure because it only adds unit tests pinning the behavior of a specific area. The category covers test machinery (runners, utilities, harnesses, linters) and explicitly excludes tests that pin the behavior of an individual area ('belongs to that area, not here').
